issues.title: Official US MY2005/MY2006 Saab VIN tables resolve prior WIS-year folder ambiguities
issues.cause: Original dated Saab Automobile USA reference archive has explicitly titled MY2005 and MY2006 tables while several WIS mirror year directories previously held contradictory model-year text or sample characters.
symptoms: vehicle year, market or engine guessed from wrong WIS folder
old sample VIN year digit interpreted as target year
5AT versus 6AT donor proposed based on 'automatic' description
issues.diagnosis_summary: Use the US-market original factory VIN table corresponding to tenth-character MY code and physically verify stamped VIN, engine, gearbox and full TCM/ECU. Check actual vehicle data against WebEPC for parts.
issues.correction_summary: Treat 2005 year code 5, 2006 code 6, gearbox position 7 and engine position 8 as source-scoped identity candidates, not a replacement approval. Original 2008/09 complete tables remain unverified.
limits: The PDF still lacks separately dated 2008 and 2009 original-year pages.
A VIN engine code denotes original equipment and does not prove a swapped engine's actual identity.
The 2005 sample VIN uses a 2004 character despite 2005 table, so don't trust examples as actual cars.

issues.title: 9-3 ignition switch formerly 12801010 cannot be replaced by 32021815 without serviceable reused mechanism
issues.cause: Saab Parts USA issued a conditional parts-service kit requiring salvage and inspection of black lower switch sliding mechanism from original ISM; new electronics alone are insufficient if the mechanical section is damaged.
symptoms: key does not rotate or key pop-out
seller markets kit 32021815 as fully complete replacement
original ISM mechanical slider cracked, fouled or lost
issues.diagnosis_summary: Physically inspect actual original old ISM and black sliding assembly, confirm moving freely and retaining tabs intact, consult Saab-specific service instructions before any electronic/key/security work.
issues.correction_summary: Only consider the manufacturer-supported kit process when the old mechanism can be reused; otherwise obtain a suitable complete alternative switch with proper VIN/part selection. No general drop-in or VIN approval claimed.
limits: Kit page specifies original 9-3 MY2003–2011 only; do not apply to OG9-5 TWICE and key system.
Not a VIN-specific current availability guarantee.
Requires retaining serviceable original black housing, not a complete direct replacement.

issues.title: 9-5 engine-mount service torque changes at factory VIN cutoff without proving a different mount part number
issues.cause: Saab original 2008 9-5 mount-left WIS requires different centre nut tightening torque through 73514478 versus from 73514479, with separate manual/automatic mounting torques.
symptoms: seller assumes any MY2008 engine mount fastener/torque interchangeable
donor mount fastener from a different gearbox or cutoff applied blindly
issues.diagnosis_summary: Confirm actual original 17-digit VIN/build, stamped hardware and full service-joint identity; apply only matching factory repair revision with competent repair procedure.
issues.correction_summary: Capture production cutoff as a service distinction, not a claimed new mount SKU, successor part or direction of interchange.
limits: Printed VIN value is abbreviated threshold and not a full VIN.
No original mount part number change verified at this cutoff.
Service fastener specification is not a structural-rust/jacking clearance criterion.

Retain serviceable original black sliding/rotating housing; ensure clean and free-moving.
Follow official key retainer/tab and aligned spring/plunger assembly procedure.

parts.title: Saab 9-3 (9440) ignition switch module repair service kit (formerly 12801010)

relationships.conditions: Manufacturer Saab Parts US says ISM 12801010 now kit 32021815, requiring old black slide housing reuse; cannot serve as fully interchangeable complete module.

requirements: Must have functioning original black lower sliding mechanism from 12801010 or another intact switch.
Check locking metal key retainer and moving electrical contacts as documented; no assumed mechanical housing in kit.
Confirm model-year/installed ignition system and obtain latest Saab WebEPC/supplier detail before ordering.
